summary: Energy Transfer LP filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a registered underwritten offering of three series of senior unsecured notes: 2032, 2037 and 2057 maturities. Principal amounts, coupons and pricing are left blank in this preliminary filing. Notes are unguaranteed at issuance, rank pari passu with existing senior unsecured debt and senior to subordinated debt, and carry make-whole calls until one, three and six months before maturity. Joint book-runners include Barclays, Deutsche Bank, Morgan Stanley, RBC and Wells Fargo. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation; watch final pricing, size and use of proceeds.
